upstreamFrontmatter.name: browser
upstreamFrontmatter.description: Drives a real browser through the omowright library from the js eval kernel: sites the user is already signed into, forms and clicks, JS-rendered pages, screenshots, web QA, extension popups, a human handoff for login, CAPTCHA or OTP, and a browser you own for scraping, bot-scored targets, network capture and QA traces. Use for any interactive browser task; not for a plain search or an unblocked static fetch.

adaptations: Restricted to user-selected local/browser/Obsidian execution; cloud, remote-provider and foreign-runtime branches disabled.
Consolidated entry point; primary resources retained and variants namespaced without overwrites.
Russian discovery metadata and task-scoped invocation policy; original descriptions retained in upstreamFrontmatter.
